resources.string: Enlarged diameter, not anatomical scale. Arrows are normalized to the current centre speed; speed is zero at the wall.

Q = π ΔP r⁴ / (8 μ L)
R = ΔP / Q = 8 μ L / (π r⁴)
v(s) = 2 v̄ [1 − (s/r)²]
τw = ΔP r / (2 L)
Equations use SI units; displayed flow is mL/min.

One rigid, straight, circular tube with steady, fully developed laminar flow, constant viscosity and no slip at the wall. The pressure drop is between the segment ends, not a blood-pressure reading. Pulsation, wall elasticity, branching, valves, blood cells and non-Newtonian effects are excluded. Controls are teaching inputs, not normal ranges or treatment targets.
